info.title: AIMOC API v1 — Candidate
info.description: NOT PRODUCTION ACCEPTED. This document describes staging + legacy compatibility routes. It does not approve real vendor, inventory evidence or final DTO parity.

x-aimoc-open-gaps.description: Legacy /api/v1/dispatches DTO lacks target allocation, mode, voyage and verified sequence evidence
Target multi-line Transfer Requests and destination allocation DTO are not fully implemented
Target Driver tasks/checklist and authenticated production assignment lifecycle missing
Weighbridge vendor-native protocol, trust chain, fault evidence and managed secret rotation not validated
Full inventory reconciliation and opening proof must be independently signed and imported
Exceptions shortfall, cancellation, skip/override, recovery DTO missing
Outbox publisher, SSE, cache invalidation and historical pagination need integration
Voyage completion, jetty cargo handoff and final destination custody DTO missing
Normalized production schema migration and rollback not approved
Final comprehensive OpenAPI 3.1 schema review, signed client-server contract and security acceptance pending
